original: Caves and swallow holes are found in the locality of Cicerana (Lecce nei Marsi), while the Acqua Ventilata waterfall is located in the municipality of Gioia dei Marsi.
translated: Höhlen und Schlucklöcher finden sich in der Ortschaft Cicerana (Lecce nei Marsi), während sich der Wasserfall Acqua Ventilata in der Gemeinde Gioia dei Marsi befindet.
